title: Decision record
description: One answered catalog question (PLAN.md section 4.3). One record per line in decisions.jsonl. Version 0; a change needs an ADR.

id.description: A catalog ID such as ae.teae.end, or custom:<slug> for a decision outside the catalog.

unit.description: The owning unit (PLAN.md section 10): a module or a table family.

value.description: The chosen alternative (rule) with its parameters. Null when there is none: the reader asked, found a conflict, or the decision does not apply.

statement.description: The standard form, rendered from the value.

binds.description: The spec elements this decision sets. Filled by the compiler.

identifiable.description: Filled by the machine, never by the agent (PLAN.md section 4.7).

allOf.description: A stated or default decision has a value and cites its document or house standard.

element_id.description: A stable element ID (PLAN.md section 4.1): a layer prefix, a colon, then printable ASCII without spaces.
